nuggets.text: Skyhawks coach Jason Simpson's son, Ty, was the No. 13 pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, by the Los Angeles Rams.
Skyhawks coach Jason Simpson played quarterback at Mississippi State, then played outfield for Southern Miss baseball.
The Skyhawks were once the Junior Volunteers and then the Pacers; the Skyhawks name arrived in 1995.
Jerry Reese, general manager of two Super Bowl champion New York Giants teams, played football at UT Martin.
Tommy Ansley ran for three TDs as the Skyhawks scored six rushing touchdowns against Chicago State, a first for them since 2022.
The Skyhawks scored the final 42 points of their 42-7 win over Chicago State.
The Skyhawks led the FCS in time of possession last season, averaging 34 minutes, 38 seconds per game.
Jason Simpson is in his 21st season leading the Skyhawks and needs three more conference wins to reach second in OVC coaching history.
The Skyhawks were voted the OVC preseason favorite, collecting six of the eight first-place votes.
Saturday is the first meeting ever between the Skyhawks and West Virginia.
